remarks: Privately nestled on 1.14 picturesque acres at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in one of North Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods, this gracious 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath Colonial offers 4,594 square feet of exceptional living space. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into a home distinguished by generous room sizes, multiple fireplaces, and a timeless floor plan designed for both elegant entertaining and comfortable everyday living. Lovingly maintained by the same family for many years, this exceptional property is ready to inspire its next owner. Rich in character and classic architectural appeal, it presents a rare opportunity to create a truly personalized residence tailored to your own taste, style, and vision. Whether preserving its enduring charm or introducing a fresh, modern aesthetic, the home's impressive scale, thoughtful layout, and exceptional setting provide the ideal canvas to craft a home that is uniquely yours. Set amidst mature trees and lush surroundings, the expansive property offers remarkable privacy, tranquility, and abundant space for outdoor living, recreation, and entertaining. Ideally located just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, shopping, dining, parks, and downtown Stamford, this distinguished North Stamford property combines the peace and privacy of cul-de-sac living with exceptional convenience.
